summary_en: This Phase 2 trial tests two dose schedules of porustobart given with pembrolizumab before surgery in adults with resectable pMMR/MSS colon cancer. Both groups receive pembrolizumab by vein on Day 1 and Day 22, and porustobart is given by vein on Day 1 only in one group or on Day 1 and Day 22 in the other, with surgery 6 to 9 weeks after starting treatment. The study measures how well the medicines destroy the cancer before surgery and what side effects occur.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 2 evalúa dos esquemas de dosis de porustobart administrados junto con pembrolizumab antes de la cirugía en adultos con cáncer de colon pMMR/MSS resecable. Ambos grupos reciben pembrolizumab por vena el Día 1 y el Día 22; el porustobart se administra por vena solo el Día 1 en un grupo, o el Día 1 y el Día 22 en el otro, y la cirugía se realiza entre 6 y 9 semanas después de iniciar el tratamiento. El estudio mide qué tan bien los medicamentos destruyen el cáncer antes de la cirugía y qué efectos secundarios ocurren.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older at the time of consent.
T3 or T4 tumor, any node status, no distant spread (M0), and disease that can be surgically removed.
Adequate tumor tissue sample with pathology report, and adequate blood, liver and kidney function.
not_for: Investigational agent taken within 3 weeks of the first dose.
Imminent or urgent need for surgery.
Prior treatment with a CTLA-4, PD-1, or PD-L1 immune checkpoint inhibitor.
Systemic corticosteroid or immunosuppressive therapy within 1 week of first dose (some exceptions apply).
Interstitial lung disease, pneumonitis needing corticosteroids, or severe hypersensitivity to a fully human antibody.
